title: Leveraged Funds
caption:
Twice the move. And twice the risk.

Meme Street has 2x and 3x long funds, plus short funds that aim to rise when prices fall. They're mostly used for short-term trades.

Losses multiply just like gains. In real markets, funds like these usually reset daily, so holding them for a long time can drift from the target, especially when markets chop.

Explore them with practice money at memestreet.net

narration: Twice the move. And twice the risk. Meme Street has leveraged and short funds. They aim to move two or three times as much as what they track, in either direction. There are 2x long funds, 3x long funds, and short funds that aim to rise when prices fall. Traders mostly use them for short-term trades, not long holds. What makes them different is that short funds can rise when the market falls. The risks? Losses multiply just like gains. In real markets, funds like these usually reset daily, so holding them for a long time can drift from the target, especially in choppy markets. Practise with them using practice money, and watch how they react to the news. Explore the 2x and 3x funds at memestreet.net.
